title: How AI Agents Actually Work (Explained Simply)
description:
What actually makes an AI "agent" different from a chatbot? In 6 minutes, no jargon: the 4 building blocks every agent shares (the brain, tools, memory and the loop), the think-act-observe loop from the ReAct paper, a step-by-step example, why many "agents" are really workflows, and where agents still fail (compounding mistakes, cost, prompt injection) - plus two questions to ask before you trust any "agentic" product.

Chapters
0:00 Intro
0:26 Chatbot vs. agent
1:11 The 4 building blocks
2:12 The agent loop
3:27 Workflows vs. agents
4:22 Where agents still fail
5:22 Recap

Sources
- Anthropic, "Building effective agents" (2024): https://www.anthropic.com/research/building-effective-agents
- Yao et al., "ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models" (Princeton & Google, 2022): https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.03629
- Gartner press release, 25 June 2025 (40% of agentic AI projects cancelled by end of 2027; 15% of decisions by 2028): https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025-06-25-gartner-predicts-over-40-percent-of-agentic-ai-projects-will-be-canceled-by-end-of-2027
- OWASP Top 10 for LLM Apps, LLM01 Prompt Injection: https://genai.owasp.org/llmrisk/llm01-prompt-injection/
